lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 4 distinct vertical line segments with irregular spacing; spacing increases significantly between the third and fourth posterior lines.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The anterior three line segments are abbreviated, terminating before the mid-point of the torso depth, while the posterior-most line extends further toward the ventral region.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A grouping of 3 distinct high-contrast white spots is visible on the lower lateral haunch.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Lyrate curvature with a spiral twist; horns project laterally from the base before curving medially toward the terminal tips.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The pixel distance between the horn tips is approximately 2.0 times the width of the horn base.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: Ivory-colored tipping accounts for approximately 15-20% of the total vertical horn length.

other_distinctive_markers: Bright orange coloration on the distal limbs ('socks') below the knee and hock; prominent white chevron marking between the eyes; high-contrast white dorsal mane along the spine.
